ram_seed.source: No computador principal que uso há 48 GB de RAM.

method: Replayed the exact archived Gemma responses from the frozen 2.2E synthetic 40-source set against the 2.2F native bridge in independent SQLite stores. No new inference and no final holdout credit. SQLite queries were read-only with query_only and quick_check. The previous dx-031/032 proposals were also replayed exactly. The failed 2.2E C RAM seed ran separately in rules mode and was reviewed as a candidate by policy, with no promotion during this diagnostic.
